# Off Leash Blog

> > Fi's Off Leash Blog combines AI-powered pet technology with expert dog care advice, powered by the world's largest canine behavior dataset.

Off Leash is Fi's official blog covering GPS dog collar technology, pet wellness, behavioral insights, and community celebrations. The blog features product announcements, health tips, seasonal guides, and data-driven stories from Fi's growing community of dog owners.

## Key Topics

- Fi Series 3+ (AI smart collar)
- Fi Mini (compact GPS tracker)
- Fi Intelligence (AI behavioral analysis)
- GPS pet tracking
- Dog health monitoring
- Canine behavior dataset
- Smart collar technology
- Pet wellness
- Dog training and care
- National Walk Your Dog Day
- Dog breed insights
- Pet anxiety management
- International expansion (UK, EU, Canada)
- Fi app and ecosystem
- Dog-owner bonding

## Product Innovation & Technology

- [The First AI Smart Collar for Your Dog: Introducing Fi Series 3+](https://blog.tryfi.com/the-first-ai-smart-collar-for-your-dog): Fi Series 3+ AI-powered smart collar with behavioral detection and health monitoring.
- [Introducing Fi Mini: The Smallest, Smartest Pet Tracker Ever Built](https://blog.tryfi.com/introducing-fi-mini): Fi Mini product launch: smallest, smartest GPS tracker for dogs and cats.
- [We Built the World's Largest Dataset of Canine Behavior. Here's What Your Dog Has Been Trying to Tell You.](https://blog.tryfi.com/we-built-the-worlds-largest-dataset-of-canine-behavior-heres-what-your-dog-has-been-trying-to-tell-you): Fi Intelligence AI analyzes world's largest canine behavior dataset to interpret dog activities.

## Dog Health & Wellness

- [8 Tips for Supporting Your Dog During 4th of July Fireworks](https://blog.tryfi.com/8-tips-for-supporting-your-dog-during-4th-of-july-fireworks): 8 practical tips to help dogs manage anxiety during 4th of July fireworks.
- [25 Ways to Make 2025 Better for You and Your Dog](https://blog.tryfi.com/25-ways-to-make-2025-better): 25 dog wellness and bonding resolutions for 2025 using Fi collar and app.

## Community & Events

- [In Celebration of National Walk Your Dog Day, Fi Reveals Which Breeds are Leading The Pack](https://blog.tryfi.com/in-celebration-of-national-walk-your-dog-day-fi-reveals-which-breeds-are-leading-the-pack): Fi community celebrates 17M walks and breed walking statistics on National Walk Day.
- [Celebrate National Walk Your Dog Day with Fi—In Person!](https://blog.tryfi.com/celebrate-national-walk-your-dog-day-with-fi): Fi hosts in-person National Walk Your Dog Day events in NYC and Austin.

## Company News & Growth

- [Fi Announces International Expansion into the UK and EU](https://blog.tryfi.com/fi-announces-international-expansion-into-the-uk-and-eu): Fi Series 3+ expands globally into UK, EU, and Canada markets.
- [Fi welcomes BARK executive Suzanne McDonnell to Board of Directors](https://blog.tryfi.com/fi-welcomes-bark-executive): Fi announces Suzanne McDonnell from BARK joins Board of Directors.

## Core Pages

- [Off Leash Blog](https://blog.tryfi.com): Fi blog homepage featuring GPS dog collars, tracking tech, health tips, and care advice.
